<Heading
  as={"h1"}

  children={"Acknowledge inbound stock for a SKU"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/stock/receive"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Stages a quantity of a SKU as received into the building (publishes StockReceived) without assigning it to a bin yet. This does NOT create a StockUnit aggregate: a StockUnit requires both an item-scan and a location-scan by construction (the stow-requires-both invariant), and a staged receipt has no bin yet. The durable, addressable record only starts at StowStock — that is why this operation returns 202 Accepted rather than 201 Created: there is no resource here to hand back a Location for.
